description: The side panel's Artifacts page: every Claude artifact published or linked in this session, as rows of the same size as Subagents rows, newest first.

parts.name: list
parts.shows: A boxed list, newest at the top; an artifact seen again (a new version) replaces its row in the same place with the newer info. Rows are removed when the session is cleared.

parts.name: row
parts.shows: Left to right: the artifact's icon (the icon its publisher named, e.g. chart, calendar; a globe if none or unknown); title (one line; "Artifact" if it has none) over a one-line subtitle: the link without https:// (claude.ai/artifact/...) cut in the middle with … if long, followed by " · v2" style version number when known ("{link} · v{version}"); then an Open button and a flat Copy-link icon button.

actions.by: click anywhere on the row, or the Open button (tooltip: the full URL)
actions.does: opens the artifact's URL in the browser
copies the URL and toasts "Link copied"
shows the artifact's description, or its URL if it has none
